title: 1 Problems
description: Analysis of our customers' live data. The system only suggests; a person decides.

options.content: 🟢 **Live (ESP32):** [Site now](/d/smart-compactor) · [Pickups](/d/live-pickups) · [Money & CO₂](/d/live-money) · [Devices](/d/edge-live)   |   📊 **Analysis (all customers):** **● 1 Problems** · [2 Cost & weight](/d/cockpit-cost) · [3 Waste companies](/d/cockpit-operators) · [4 Invoices](/d/cockpit-actions)

### What went wrong — from the board's own measurements and the checked invoices
Pick a **customer** or **waste company** at the top. An **issue** is counted once: one per lift that was emptied too early or left full too long, and a device fault once per compactor per hour. The AI's opinion on each lift is shown in the event log, not counted again. **Charged too much** is proven by our measurement; **needs proof** = a surcharge or penalty the sensor cannot check.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS v FROM pickups p JOIN compactors c ON c.id = p.compactor_id JOIN materials m ON m.name = c.material WHERE p.status = 'done' AND c.customer_name IN ($customer) AND c.operator_name IN ($operator) AND $__timeFilter(p.done_at)

SELECT round(sum(p.kg_collected)) AS v FROM pickups p JOIN compactors c ON c.id = p.compactor_id JOIN materials m ON m.name = c.material WHERE p.status = 'done' AND c.customer_name IN ($customer) AND c.operator_name IN ($operator) AND $__timeFilter(p.done_at)

panels.title: Issues
panels.description: One per lift judged too early / too late, plus device faults (same fault, same compactor, same hour = one).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS v FROM (SELECT p.done_at AS ts, c.customer_name, p.compactor_id, c.operator_name, CASE p.verdict WHEN 'TOO_EARLY' THEN 'Emptied too early (<60%)' ELSE 'Left full 2h+' END AS problem, p.verdict_reason AS what, 1 AS times FROM pickups p JOIN compactors c ON c.id = p.compactor_id WHERE p.status = 'done' AND p.verdict IN ('TOO_EARLY', 'TOO_LATE') AND c.customer_name IN ($customer) AND c.operator_name IN ($operator) AND $__timeFilter(p.done_at) UNION ALL SELECT min(a.ts), c.customer_name, a.compactor_id, c.operator_name, CASE a.type WHEN 'pickup_too_early' THEN 'Emptied too early (<60%)' WHEN 'pickup_too_late' THEN 'Left full 2h+' WHEN 'ml_premature_unjustified' THEN 'AI: lift not needed' WHEN 'ml_delayed_collection' THEN 'AI: lift came late' WHEN 'ml_anomaly' THEN 'AI: unusual reading' WHEN 'contamination' THEN 'Wrong material (density)' WHEN 'spike' THEN 'Sensor spike' WHEN 'sensor_stuck' THEN 'Sensor stuck' WHEN 'sensor_fault' THEN 'Sensor fault' WHEN 'data_gap' THEN 'No data' WHEN 'zero_shift' THEN 'Scale not zero after emptying' WHEN 'overload' THEN 'Overloaded' WHEN 'unexpected_drop' THEN 'Weight dropped without emptying' WHEN 'signature_invalid' THEN 'Reading tampered / wrong key' ELSE a.type END, min(a.message), count(*) FROM alerts a JOIN compactors c ON c.id = a.compactor_id WHERE a.type IN ('spike', 'sensor_stuck', 'sensor_fault', 'data_gap', 'zero_shift', 'overload', 'unexpected_drop', 'signature_invalid', 'contamination') AND c.customer_name IN ($customer) AND c.operator_name IN ($operator) AND $__timeFilter(a.ts) GROUP BY c.customer_name, a.compactor_id, c.operator_name, a.type, date_trunc('hour', a.ts)) x

panels.title: Invoices to check
panels.description: Invoices where a line differs from the measurement and nobody decided yet.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS v FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.* FROM invoice_decisions d JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM invoice_decisions GROUP BY invoice_id) m ON m.max_id = d.id) d ON d.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.customer_name IN ($customer) AND i.operator_name IN ($operator) AND i.suggestion = 'CHECK' AND d.decision IS NULL

panels.title: Charged too much
panels.description: Billed more than the board measured or than the customer's prices.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(sum(i.overcharged_eur)::numeric) AS v FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.* FROM invoice_decisions d JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM invoice_decisions GROUP BY invoice_id) m ON m.max_id = d.id) d ON d.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.customer_name IN ($customer) AND i.operator_name IN ($operator)

panels.title: Needs proof
panels.description: Surcharges and penalties the sensor cannot prove or disprove: ask for evidence.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(sum(i.unverified_eur)::numeric) AS v FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.* FROM invoice_decisions d JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM invoice_decisions GROUP BY invoice_id) m ON m.max_id = d.id) d ON d.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.customer_name IN ($customer) AND i.operator_name IN ($operator)

SELECT problem AS "Problem", count(*) AS "Issues" FROM (SELECT p.done_at AS ts, c.customer_name, p.compactor_id, c.operator_name, CASE p.verdict WHEN 'TOO_EARLY' THEN 'Emptied too early (<60%)' ELSE 'Left full 2h+' END AS problem, p.verdict_reason AS what, 1 AS times FROM pickups p JOIN compactors c ON c.id = p.compactor_id WHERE p.status = 'done' AND p.verdict IN ('TOO_EARLY', 'TOO_LATE') AND c.customer_name IN ($customer) AND c.operator_name IN ($operator) AND $__timeFilter(p.done_at) UNION ALL SELECT min(a.ts), c.customer_name, a.compactor_id, c.operator_name, CASE a.type WHEN 'pickup_too_early' THEN 'Emptied too early (<60%)' WHEN 'pickup_too_late' THEN 'Left full 2h+' WHEN 'ml_premature_unjustified' THEN 'AI: lift not needed' WHEN 'ml_delayed_collection' THEN 'AI: lift came late' WHEN 'ml_anomaly' THEN 'AI: unusual reading' WHEN 'contamination' THEN 'Wrong material (density)' WHEN 'spike' THEN 'Sensor spike' WHEN 'sensor_stuck' THEN 'Sensor stuck' WHEN 'sensor_fault' THEN 'Sensor fault' WHEN 'data_gap' THEN 'No data' WHEN 'zero_shift' THEN 'Scale not zero after emptying' WHEN 'overload' THEN 'Overloaded' WHEN 'unexpected_drop' THEN 'Weight dropped without emptying' WHEN 'signature_invalid' THEN 'Reading tampered / wrong key' ELSE a.type END, min(a.message), count(*) FROM alerts a JOIN compactors c ON c.id = a.compactor_id WHERE a.type IN ('spike', 'sensor_stuck', 'sensor_fault', 'data_gap', 'zero_shift', 'overload', 'unexpected_drop', 'signature_invalid', 'contamination') AND c.customer_name IN ($customer) AND c.operator_name IN ($operator) AND $__timeFilter(a.ts) GROUP BY c.customer_name, a.compactor_id, c.operator_name, a.type, date_trunc('hour', a.ts)) x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Issues — newest first (times = how often the same fault repeated within the hour)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "Time", customer_name AS "Customer", compactor_id AS "Compactor", operator_name AS "Waste company", problem AS "Problem", what AS "What the data shows", times AS "Times" FROM (SELECT p.done_at AS ts, c.customer_name, p.compactor_id, c.operator_name, CASE p.verdict WHEN 'TOO_EARLY' THEN 'Emptied too early (<60%)' ELSE 'Left full 2h+' END AS problem, p.verdict_reason AS what, 1 AS times FROM pickups p JOIN compactors c ON c.id = p.compactor_id WHERE p.status = 'done' AND p.verdict IN ('TOO_EARLY', 'TOO_LATE') AND c.customer_name IN ($customer) AND c.operator_name IN ($operator) AND $__timeFilter(p.done_at) UNION ALL SELECT min(a.ts), c.customer_name, a.compactor_id, c.operator_name, CASE a.type WHEN 'pickup_too_early' THEN 'Emptied too early (<60%)' WHEN 'pickup_too_late' THEN 'Left full 2h+' WHEN 'ml_premature_unjustified' THEN 'AI: lift not needed' WHEN 'ml_delayed_collection' THEN 'AI: lift came late' WHEN 'ml_anomaly' THEN 'AI: unusual reading' WHEN 'contamination' THEN 'Wrong material (density)' WHEN 'spike' THEN 'Sensor spike' WHEN 'sensor_stuck' THEN 'Sensor stuck' WHEN 'sensor_fault' THEN 'Sensor fault' WHEN 'data_gap' THEN 'No data' WHEN 'zero_shift' THEN 'Scale not zero after emptying' WHEN 'overload' THEN 'Overloaded' WHEN 'unexpected_drop' THEN 'Weight dropped without emptying' WHEN 'signature_invalid' THEN 'Reading tampered / wrong key' ELSE a.type END, min(a.message), count(*) FROM alerts a JOIN compactors c ON c.id = a.compactor_id WHERE a.type IN ('spike', 'sensor_stuck', 'sensor_fault', 'data_gap', 'zero_shift', 'overload', 'unexpected_drop', 'signature_invalid', 'contamination') AND c.customer_name IN ($customer) AND c.operator_name IN ($operator) AND $__timeFilter(a.ts) GROUP BY c.customer_name, a.compactor_id, c.operator_name, a.type, date_trunc('hour', a.ts)) x ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Invoice lines that do not match the measurement

targets.rawSql: SELECT i.invoice_id AS "Invoice", i.operator_name AS "Waste company", CASE l.line_type WHEN 'LIFT_FEE' THEN 'Lift fee' WHEN 'MATERIAL_CREDIT' THEN 'Material credit' WHEN 'PROCESSING' THEN 'Processing' WHEN 'HAULAGE' THEN 'Haulage' WHEN 'SURCHARGE' THEN 'Surcharge' WHEN 'PENALTY' THEN 'Penalty' WHEN 'OTHER' THEN 'Other' ELSE l.line_type END AS "Line", l.compactor_id AS "Compactor", l.service_date AS "Date", l.amount_eur AS "Billed €", l.expected_eur AS "Should be €", l.difference_eur AS "Difference €", CASE l.check_status WHEN 'OK' THEN 'ok' WHEN 'WRONG_PRICE' THEN 'wrong price' WHEN 'NO_LIFT' THEN 'no lift measured' WHEN 'DUPLICATE' THEN 'billed twice' WHEN 'WEIGHT_MISMATCH' THEN 'weight differs' WHEN 'NO_EVIDENCE' THEN 'needs proof' WHEN 'UNKNOWN_COMPACTOR' THEN 'not their compactor' ELSE l.check_status END AS "Check", l.check_reason AS "Why" FROM invoice_lines l JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_id = l.invoice_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.* FROM invoice_decisions d JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM invoice_decisions GROUP BY invoice_id) m ON m.max_id = d.id) d ON d.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.customer_name IN ($customer) AND i.operator_name IN ($operator) AND l.check_status <> 'OK' ORDER BY l.difference_eur DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 500
